events.doc: A travelling node wobbles in full at this speed, in layout units per second, and less below it.

events.name: DRIFT_GAP
events.doc: A travelling node wobbles in full this far from its target, in layout units, and less nearer.

events.name: travelDrift
events.signature: function travelDrift(gap: number, speed: number): number
events.doc: How strongly a travelling node wobbles, 0–1, from how far it still has to go and how fast it is going (both in layout units). A node setting off from rest or arriving at its target reads 0, so the wobble neither kicks in nor cuts out: it swells and fades with the journey, and is exactly 0 at rest.

events.name: isActive
events.doc: Whether node `index`'s spring is moving.

events.name: gapOf
events.doc: How far node `index` is from its target now; 0 at rest.

events.name: speedOf
events.doc: How fast node `index` moves now; 0 at rest.

events.name: ATTENTION_RISE_TAU
events.doc: Edges ease toward their attention with these time constants (seconds): lit in, dimmed out.

events.name: ATTENTION_SNAP
events.doc: Within this of its target an edge's attention snaps there: under one 8-bit step.

events.name: advance
events.doc: Let `ms` pass with no frame (a timer's wait).

events.name: viewAt
events.signature: viewAt = (checkpoint: number, pickedId: string | null = null)

events.name: still
events.doc: Every node's offset target and drawn position, to compare before and after.

events.name: readingView
events.doc: The reading's view at a checkpoint, as the gathering sees it: members and links only.

events.name: at
events.doc: The cluster at `checkpoint`, gathering every earlier checkpoint first if needed.

events.name: NodeTraits
events.doc: A node's fixed personality: how stiff its spring and how it wobbles.

events.name: NodeSprings
events.doc: Per-node springs over three axes, stepped by semi-implicit Euler: `v += ((target − x) k − 17 v) dt; x += v dt`. A spring at rest leaves the active set and holds exactly its target, so a settled field costs nothing; aiming it again at the target it holds leaves it at rest.

events.name: setScale
events.doc: Rescale the rest threshold with the layout. At rest within 0.05 unit (well under a pixel at any zoom), so the softest, overdamped springs stop crawling within about five seconds.

events.name: setTarget
events.doc: Aim node `index` at `target`. The targets are float32, so the comparison is made at float32: a target that rounds to the one held is no change, and a spring at rest stays at rest.

events.name: displace
events.doc: Put a spring somewhere at once, keeping its target: it springs back from there.

events.name: hold
events.doc: Hold a spring at a value: value, target, and rest at once (a drag).

events.name: step
events.doc: Advance by `dt` seconds (clamped). Returns whether any spring is still moving.

events.name: easeAttention
events.signature: function easeAttention(current: number, target: number, dt: number): number
events.doc: Attention easing for edges: exponential toward the target, so a hover's edges light or dim fully within half a second, then snap and stop.

events.name: SpringField
events.doc: Critically damped springs over a flat array of values: node offsets (three values per node), or style channels (one per node). A spring reaches its target without overshoot, and once within tolerance it snaps to the target and leaves the active set, so a settled field costs nothing per frame.

events.name: setTarget
events.doc: Aim spring `index` at a target; it moves only if the target differs. The targets are float32, so the comparison is made at float32: a target that rounds to the one held is no change, and a spring at rest stays at rest.

events.name: step
events.doc: Advance the active springs by `dt` seconds; returns whether any is still moving.

events.name: setup
events.signature: function setup( renderMs: number | null = 2.5, { whole = false, synced = false }: { whole?: boolean; synced?: boolean } = {}, )
events.doc: `renderMs` is what the recording drawer reports for its render call; null renders nothing. `whole` shows the whole memory (no gathering). `synced` runs performance.now and timers on the manual clock, for what the renderer times by the wall clock (rises, the story's fall).

events.name: glideFrom
events.doc: Switch layouts without a jump or a crawl: every spring snaps to its new target and each node glides from where it was drawn (`from`) to its new place on one eased curve. A glide is a change of view, not a transition in the reading, so nothing drifts after it.

events.name: step
events.doc: Advance everything by `dt` at clock `now` (seconds); returns whether anything still moves.

events.name: settle
events.doc: Snap every spring and ease to its end and upload: nothing drifts afterwards.

events.name: atlas
events.signature: atlas = { texture: new Texture(), glyphSize: 64, exponent: 9 }

events.name: glyphsOf
events.doc: A name's glyphs as a typesetter would give them: one unit-wide glyph per letter.

events.name: frame
events.signature: function frame( layer: LabelLayer, labels: ReadonlyArray<{ node: number; name: string; x: number; opacity: number }>, )
events.doc: Draw `labels` as one frame, writing any glyphs a slot is waiting for.

events.name: fillAt
events.doc: Where a slot's fill opacity sits in the slot texture: row 1, first channel.

events.name: Glyphs
events.doc: The glyphs a label draws, as troika typeset them at font size 1, anchored left and middle.

events.name: SdfAtlas
events.doc: Troika's shared SDF atlas and how its glyphs are encoded.

events.name: Typeset
events.signature: type Typeset = ( name: string, font: string | undefined, done: (glyphs: Glyphs) => void, ) => void
events.doc: Typeset `name` in `font` and call back with its glyphs (possibly later).

events.name: troikaTypeset
events.doc: Troika's typesetter: a worker lays out the name and fills the shared SDF atlas.

events.name: MAX_LABEL_GLYPHS
events.doc: Longer names are cut to this many glyphs: nobody reads a longer label.

events.name: OUTLINE_EDGE
events.doc: The outline's width, as troika's "12%": an eighth of the font size, in font-size units.

events.name: vertexShader
events.signature: vertexShader = /* glsl */ ` uniform sampler2D uSlots; uniform float uSlotCount; uniform float uWorldPerPixel; uniform vec2 uSdfSize; uniform float uGlyphSize; uniform float uEdge; attribute vec4 aBou…

events.name: fragmentShader
events.signature: fragmentShader = /* glsl */ ` uniform sampler2D uSdf; uniform float uGlyphSize; uniform float uExponent; uniform float uEdge; uniform vec3 uColor; varying vec2 vGlyphUv; varying vec4 vUvBounds; varyi…

events.name: TEXELS_PER_ROW
events.doc: Per-slot floats in the slot texture: x, y, size (row 0); fill and outline opacity (row 1).

events.name: LabelLayer
events.doc: One layer of labels: `slots` labels at most, each up to `glyphs` glyphs. With `outlined`, a paper outline pass draws under the fills.

events.name: used
events.doc: Slots in use at most so far (what the draw covers).

events.name: slotTexture
events.doc: The slot texture, for tests: its version counts uploads.

events.name: setColors
events.doc: Ink for the fills; paper for the outline pass.

events.name: setWorldPerPixel
events.doc: World units per CSS pixel: the camera's zoom, the only thing a zoom changes here.

events.name: forgetGlyphs
events.doc: Every name must be typeset again (a new font).

events.name: place
events.signature: place( node: number, name: string, x: number, y: number, size: number, fill: number, outline: number, ): number
events.doc: Draw note `node`'s label this frame at world (x, y), `size` CSS pixels, with fill and outline opacities. Returns the slot it holds.

events.name: pending
events.signature: pending(): Array<{ readonly slot: number; readonly name: string }>
events.doc: Slots whose name is wanted but not written yet: the caller typesets them.

events.name: waiting
events.doc: Whether any slot waits for its glyphs: most frames none does.

events.name: setGlyphs
events.signature: setGlyphs(slot: number, name: string, glyphs: Glyphs): boolean
events.doc: Write `glyphs` into `slot` for `name`, if the slot still wants that name. Returns whether it did.

events.name: syncAtlas
events.doc: Read the atlas's size each frame: troika grows it in place as glyphs arrive.

events.name: setGraph
events.signature: setGraph(universe: Universe, state: NodeState, _edgeStyle: EdgeStyle): void

events.signature: draw(frame: FlatFrame, gpu: GpuTimer | null): number | null
